question: Who recently created history by becoming the first Indian cricketer to score multiple IPL centuries in less than 50 balls?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhishek Sharma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma** created history by becoming the **first Indian cricketer** to score **multiple IPL centuries in less than 50 balls** on **April 21, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma**, playing for **Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH)**, scored a **47-ball century** against **Delhi Capitals** at the **Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad**.
 
• This was his second IPL century in under 50 balls. His first was a **40-ball century** against **Punjab Kings** on **April 12, 2025**.
 
• He reached his hundred by hitting **Nitish Rana** for a six during the 15th over.
 
• He remained unbeaten on **135 runs** from **68 balls**, which included **10 fours and 10 sixes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fastest 100 by an Indian in IPL:** The record is held by **Vaibhav Sooryavanshi**, who scored a century in **35 balls** for **Rajasthan Royals** against **Gujarat Titans** on **April 28, 2025**, at the age of 14.
 
• **Other Indians** to score sub-50 ball centuries in IPL include **Yusuf Pathan (37 balls)**, **Priyansh Arya (39 balls)**, **Virat Kohli (47 balls)**, and **Tilak Varma (45 balls)**, though none have achieved it multiple times besides Abhishek Sharma.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Player Profile:** **Abhishek Sharma** is a left-handed batter hailing from **Amritsar**.
 
• **Rankings:** As per the provided news, he currently tops the **ICC T20I batter’s rankings**.
